movelist.name: Smack Down
movelist.effect: The target is knocked down to ground level, and loses all Sky or Levitate Speeds for 3 turns. During this time, they may be hit by Ground-Type Moves even if normally immune.

movelist.name: Charge
movelist.effect: If the user performs an Electric Move on their next turn that deals damage, add its Damage Dice Roll an extra time to the damage. Raise the user’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Steamroller
movelist.effect: Steamroller Flinches the target on 15+. If the target is Small, Steamroller deals an additional +5 Damage.

movelist.name: Rock Polish
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Rock Head
abilities.effect: The user ignores the Recoil keyword when attacking. If the user moves at least 4 meters in a straight line towards a foe before attacking that foe with a physical attack, they may add a +2d6 Bonus to the Damage Roll against that foe.

abilities.name: Magnet Pull
abilities.effect: Pick Two Effects; - The target is pushed or pulled X meters directly away or towards the user. X is up to 6 meters minus the target’s Weight Class. - Until the end of the user’s next turn, the target may not move more then 6 meters away from the user . - Until the end of the user’s next turn, the target may not move closer than 3 meters ot the user.
